title: Design Director
intro: Robotics companies come to us for two things at once: a brand the market believes in and a product operators actually want to use. Most studios can do one. We do both, and we need a Design Director who can lead across that whole surface — identity, UX/UI, and the video and motion that bring a robot to life before anyone sees it in person.
You'll set the creative direction, grow the team, and still be the person who opens the file and shows how it's done.
workOn: Build robot brands and identity systems that hold up on a trade-show booth, a pitch deck, and the machine itself
Direct UX/UI for operator interfaces, fleet dashboards, and 0-to-1 products — from a scrappy V1 to the long-term vision
Direct launch and product videos: concept, script, storyboard, shoot, and edit
Work closely with our motion designer to turn ideas into animation that explains complex tech in seconds
Mentor designers through regular critique, clear feedback, and pairing on real work
Jump into the file when it matters — sketch the direction, design the key screen, set the bar by example
Partner with founders, PMs, and engineers to bring clarity to hard problems
Shape how we work so the studio gets faster and the output gets better
bring: 8+ years in design, with senior or director-level experience at an agency or studio
A portfolio that shows both brand identity and UX/UI at a high level — we need to see both
Experience directing video: you've taken a piece from concept to final cut and know how to brief and guide a motion designer
A track record of managing designers — you give feedback people can act on and you know how to grow someone's craft
Hands-on skill that's still sharp. You lead from the canvas, not just from the meeting
Comfort presenting to founders and defending a creative point of view
Bonus: experience with robotics, hardware, or deep-tech clients
howWeWork: We design together, not in silos
We “steal brains” — learning from every project, client, and teammate.
We care about clarity, speed, and impact.
We’re explorers: curious, adaptive, and focused on progress
applySteps: One project you’re proud of & why (tweet length)
outro: If you’re ready to turn robots and AI into products humans adore, we’d love to meet you.
